summary: 收口 PROJECT-01 依赖链：网关预留账本与 AI 总开关、画像冻结/恢复默认、反馈幂等与撤销回放、太难不作负例、不足五篇原因、种子逐个状态、迁移前备份、删除项目清理、跨项目不降级种子、草稿取消；离线本地基线对比；任务状态按证据收口（BUDGET-01 done，其余 review 并列缺失输入）。 独立审查的 3 个重要问题（异常种子在项目写入后外抛、取消收藏后重复“有用”不重新保存、冻结内撤销不生效）及 seed 关系客户端注入、基线措辞已修复。

budget_impact.rationale: 本单元只收紧网关（先预留后发送、日/月分别检查、AI 总开关、未批准操作强制本地）并新增零 token 本地路径；未新增或放宽任何预算操作，project_guidance 仍 owner_approved=false。离线基线工具 0 token、0 网络。
budget_impact.before: 网关按操作上限记账；project_guidance 未批准强制本地；运行时新增 token 0。
budget_impact.after: 上限与操作登记不变；新增拒绝路径（AI 关闭、在途预留超限）只会减少调用。运行时新增 token 0。

checks.note: 281 ran: 258 passed, 0 failures; 23 errors are all PermissionError on local port binding in the sandbox (HTTP tests not run). New routes additionally exercised via socketpair against the real Handler: 15/15.

reviews.note: Checked task status against evidence and dependencies, privacy/budget failure paths, undo/freeze invariants and project isolation. Supplementary checks recorded in docs/evidence/2026-09-30-project01-chain-checks.txt (not harness-registered): node --test tests/*.cjs 35/35; socketpair route checks 15/15; desktop build exit 0 with ad-hoc re-sign and codesign --verify --deep --strict exit 0; tools/reuse_baseline.py exit 0 (exploratory); git diff --check exit 0.

Pass with fixes, no blockers. Findings #1-#3 (important) and #9, #11 fixed with regression tests; remaining minor findings tracked as open risks. The fixes were not re-reviewed by the independent reviewer.

open_risks: harness review fails on the tests check: exit 1 is recorded honestly because 23 HTTP tests hit PermissionError on port binding in this sandbox. Rerun the full suite with local binding allowed, then update the record.
HTTP tests (23) could not bind a port in this sandbox; rerun the full suite where local binding is allowed before release.
Eight chain tasks remain in review awaiting owner inputs listed in harness/tasks.json missing_inputs; no quality gate is claimed passed.
project_guidance and all AI paths made zero live calls; runtime token use and tokenizer parity remain unmeasured.

The worktree also contains earlier uncommitted units (graph/profile redesign, profile truth, project guidance) and unrelated files (docs/design/logo/*, .claude/launch.json); they are listed only because review requires full worktree coverage and were not re-reviewed here.
Settings fields recommendCount/decayWindow/newPaperBoost/sources/updateFrequency/timePreference are persisted but not used by the backend.

Unfixed minor review findings: restore-default clears pins on pre-change projects (#4), profile base read from the global latest version (#5), evidence panels use live feedback while frozen (#6), same-version pre-migration backup never refreshed (#7), concurrent double-click can insert duplicate feedback rows (#8), no HTTP delete-project route and legacy guidance sessions lack project_id (#10), gateway ledger lock is per-process (#13).
Earlier unit records are dated 2026-10-01, after this unit's date (review #12); left unchanged.
The manual creation page redirects 0.5 s after showing per-seed results, so failed seeds are easy to miss.

docs/design/logo/* was being changed concurrently by a separate logo workstream during this unit (files replaced 18:59-19:07); it is listed only for worktree coverage and was neither authored nor reviewed here.
